title: Qbian61 forum-java commit 20f7e68 through commit 63152c4 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Qbian61 forum-java between commits 20f7e68 and 63152c4. Authenticated users can inject malicious scripts via unsanitized comment content rendered using jQuery .html() in the reply dialog. Exploitation involves posting comments with img onerror payloads that execute when victims click Reply, allowing theft of non-HttpOnly session cookies and potential account hijacking, including administrator accounts.
